Based on my analysis of your codebase, I can see that your application uses Appwrite for authentication and has a role-based system where users can be either 'user' or 'admin'. To set the user with ID `689e28fe002e2a63e1c1` as an admin, you have several options:

## Option 1: Using the API Client (Recommended)

Your application has an `updateProfile` method in the API client that can update user profiles. You can use this to update the user's role:

```typescript
// In your admin dashboard or a management script
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Update the user's role to admin
await apiClient.updateProfile({
  id: '689e28fe002e2a63e1c1',
  role: 'admin'
});
```

## Option 2: Direct API Call

You can make a direct API call to your backend:

```typescript
const updateUserRole = async (userId: string, role: 'user' | 'admin') => {
  const response = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL}/profiles/${userId}`, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access_token')}`
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ role })
  });
  
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error('Failed to update user role');
  }
  
  return response.json();
};

// Usage
await updateUserRole('689e28fe002e2a63e1c1', 'admin');
```

## Option 3: Add to Admin Dashboard

You could add a user management section to your admin dashboard. Here's how you could implement it:

```typescript:src/components/admin/AdminUserManager.tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { apiClient, BackendUserProfile } from '@/lib/api-client';
import { useToast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';

interface AdminUserManagerProps {
  users: BackendUserProfile[];
  onUserUpdate: () => void;
}

const AdminUserManager = ({ users, onUserUpdate }: AdminUserManagerProps) => {
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const updateUserRole = async (userId: string, newRole: 'user' | 'admin') => {
    setUpdating(userId);
    try {
      await apiClient.updateProfile({
        id: userId,
        role: newRole
      });
      
      toast({
        title: 'نقش کاربر بروزرسانی شد',
        description: `نقش کاربر به ${newRole === 'admin' ? 'مدیر' : 'کاربر'} تغییر یافت`,
      });
      
      onUserUpdate();
    } catch (error) {
      toast({
        title: 'خطا در بروزرسانی نقش',
        description: 'مشکلی در تغییر نقش کاربر پیش آمد',
        variant: 'destructive',
      });
    } finally {
      setUpdating(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">مدیریت کاربران</h3>
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        {users.map((user) => (
          <div key={user.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 border rounded-lg">
            <div>
              <p className="font-medium">{user.email}</p>
              <Badge variant={user.role === 'admin' ? 'default' : 'secondary'}>
                {user.role === 'admin' ? 'مدیر' : 'کاربر'}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="space-x-2">
              {user.role === 'user' ? (
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => updateUserRole(user.id, 'admin')}
                  disabled={updating === user.id}
                >
                  {updating === user.id ? 'در حال بروزرسانی...' : 'تبدیل به مدیر'}
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => updateUserRole(user.id, 'user')}
                  disabled={updating === user.id}
                >
                  {updating === user.id ? 'در حال بروزرسانی...' : 'تبدیل به کاربر'}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default AdminUserManager;
```

## Option 4: Quick Script (for immediate use)

If you need to do this immediately, you can run this in your browser console while logged in as an admin:

```javascript
// Make sure you're logged in as an admin first
const updateUserRole = async (userId, role) => {
  const response = await fetch('https://nest.arzansite.com/api/profiles/' + userId, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${localStorage.getItem('access_token')}`
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ role })
  });
  
  if (response.ok) {
    console.log('User role updated successfully');
    return response.json();
  } else {
    console.error('Failed to update user role');
  }
};

// Update the specific user to admin
updateUserRole('689e28fe002e2a63e1c1', 'admin');
```

## Important Notes:

1. **Authentication Required**: You must be logged in as an admin user to perform this operation
2. **Backend Permissions**: Your backend should have proper authorization checks to ensure only admins can update user roles
3. **Database Update**: The change will be reflected in your Appwrite database
4. **Session Refresh**: The user may need to log out and log back in for the role change to take effect

The most straightforward approach would be to use **Option 1** with the existing `apiClient.updateProfile()` method, as it's already integrated into your application's authentication and error handling system.
